title: Cumulative Oscillation Count in Integer Range
description:
The "oscillation" or "waviness" of a number is determined by the total count of its relative extrema (peaks and valleys) among its digits. A digit is a peak if it is strictly larger than both its neighbors, and a valley if it is strictly smaller. Boundary digits (first and last) are never peaks or valleys. Numbers with fewer than 3 digits have a waviness of 0.

Example 1
Input: 120 130
Output: 3

Example 2
Input: 198 202
Output: 3

Example 3
Input: 4848 4848
Output: 2
input_format:
The first line contains an integer L.
The second line contains an integer R.
output_format: Print the sum of waviness values for all integers in the given range.
